label: UAE University Libraries ID
missing: Nothing substantial: the MARC (LC NAF copy n 79021164) is captured fully, including 400 variants, 500/663 pseudonyms, 670 sources, 370/374/375 fields and the 998 cluster.
label_issues: status 'wrong_page' / resolved false is misleading. The HTML shell is blank, but the VIAF 'processed' JSON is exactly the UAE record for him: entity_on_page true, 111 values, 8 Wikidata matches. It should read as resolved through data (ok, with a note that the HTML never renders), not as a wrong page. Element placement is also odd: the notes say 'Clemens, Samuel Langhorne' goes under name_variant, but the profile puts it under related_agent.
notable: VIAF cluster members include a mis-clustered NKC jx20050822002 (Olivia Langdon Clemens) and PLWABN Karłowicz, which are excluded correctly. LC n 82045653 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)' is excluded correctly.

label_issues: status 'wrong_page' / resolved false is misleading. The VIAF 'processed' JSON is the NLI record N6I vtls000050376 (a copy of LC n79021164), with 177 values, 046 exact dates, and 370/374. It should read as resolved through data (blank HTML shell), not as a wrong page.
notable: same_as includes https://www.idref.fr/137182333. The reviewers flagged it as an IdRef pseudonym record (Alden/Conte), a different authority from the Mark Twain record, so it is a cluster-neighbour link rather than a strict sameAs. related_agent (Fraser, Beard, Hurst, Kiely, Gewirtz) comes from VIAF 950 co-author enrichment, not from NLI's own record.
